messages:
Maria: Heads-up — Acme asked about "bundle upgrades": they'd like minimal downtime for private deploys and a guaranteed patch window. Can we map tradeoffs? :thinking:

Alex: quick q — do they mean in-place rolling patches or snapshot-and-replace? which installer?

Maria: they run private onprem v1 installer (helm+operator) and have 3 AZs. Want to avoid tenant downtime >5m, and expect monthly security patches.

Chris: I sketched two options: rolling operator-driven delta patches (hot swap pods, KV cache warming) vs offline bundle (pull tarball, stop nodes, replace binaries). Rolling keeps traffic but needs runtime migration code.

Sam: cost/complexity: rolling needs runtime compatibility helpers and can double peak resource during rollout. offline bundle simpler but needs maintenance window and maybe DB migration mode.

Evan: from infra: for rolling we'll need readiness probe tweaks and staged cache prewarm: plan:
```
1) create new pod revision with feature flag
2) warm kv cache via prefetch endpoint
3) drain traffic from old pods
4) validate model artifacts checksum
```
Also needs operator support for canary routing.

Maria: For SLAs, customers require "no data loss, <=5m tail latency spike, and 99.9% of requests served by primary region" — we should document acceptable risk and whether we offer SLA credits for forced maintenance.

Alex: Suggest we add explicit "upgrade-mode" flag to the installer: "rolling|offline|canary" and expose fallback: auto-roll-back on healthcheck failure.

Sam: field asks: provide clear customer comms template + recommended maintenance window length per scale tier.

Chris: propose bundling patches into monthly "minor" vs urgent "security hotfix" lanes — hotfix should support offline apply with shorter tested path.

deploy-bot: VCS tag created: release/2026-03-private-bundle-proposal

Maria: next steps: write short PRD with launch criteria: automated operator path + docs + one OSS customer pilot + rollback playbook. Can someone own PRD by EOD Friday?

Alex: I'll take PRD. Will sync with Eng-Platform and SRE. :thumbsup:

Evan: I'll prototype cache prewarm endpoint and share perf numbers.

Sam: I'll draft comms template + ops checklist.

Maria: thanks — let's sync Thursday 10am to review PRD draft. @channel please react if you're blocked.
